purpose: Privileged policy-support teacher and content-address-separated absolute rank16 compiler trained on successful, learner, source and shared multi-state responses.

information_wall.held5: privileged transform and frozen inference only; zero shared gradient and zero code fitting
q_pi_inputs: exact language and action-hidden correct-video event anchors
full successful-occupancy eight-phase source-subtracted action response
successful and learner occupancy full-layer source/expert owner responses
source, stable-shared and learner-policy counterfactual responses

model.prior_only_surface: exact complete rank16 gauge-canonical stable shared prior
model.full_process_surface: direct absolute complete rank16 LoRA; no stable-prior factor residual
model.q_pi_gate: member x event x owner content gate, bounded by visible event presence
model.program_content: owner/layer/family are tensor addresses; no additive address embeddings in visible Program values or q_pi factor values
model.compiler_content_path: addresses affect keys, queries and locality only; values and factor hidden states require Program content
model.query_content_modulation: target/rank query multiplicatively modulates cross-attended Program values; zero Program content remains zero output
model.factor_head_init_basis: 0.4 times family A/B weight std implied by the 47 gauge-canonical successful-member RMS values

data.video_sampling: without replacement deterministic per task visit
data.phase_source: fit19-frozen 350-to-32 whitening of complete 50x7 successful trajectory responses
data.learner_states: 30 frozen fit19 projected-policy trajectories; verified successes full weight and failures member-agreement/outcome weighted

policy_support.horizon_compression: orthonormal DCT low-frequency basis after complete 50-token full-layer owner projection

objective.effective_update: exact gauge-invariant BA Frobenius loss through rank-sized Gram matrices
objective.canonical_factor_warmstart: compact rank16 SVD gauge for direct A/B coordinate supervision; never a closed-loop selector
objective.functional_response: paired complete PI0.5 flow response on alternating successful and learner multi-phase occupancy
objective.prior_counterfactual: language+scene with process absent remains near the full stable-prior LoRA

optimization.distributed: manual flat gradient mean, deferred NCCL, task-equal

materialization.sampling: fixed correct action-hidden videos without replacement
materialization.output: one privileged q_pi consensus rank16 LoRA per task

gate2.failure_action: stop before q_V; repair the earliest q_pi/compiler/support interface instead of tuning rank, seed, dtype, or tiny LR sweeps
